usedFor: Drip holds subscribers and email activity, and “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities adds a wait after “New Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscriber Receives Email” in Drip, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: It holds the workflow for X minutes after a subscriber gets an email, so later steps run after a gap.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only waits and changes nothing in Drip, so a step has to follow it.
